Some power stations are nearly silent at low charging speeds but become noticeably loud during fast charging.

I'd prioritize models that offer:

Adjustable AC charging speed, ideally 200–400 W.

Low fan noise, preferably below 30 dB during charging.

Quiet or silent charging mode, rather than just a quiet inverter when discharging.

The distinction matters because a power station advertised as 25 dB may achieve that only while powering devices, not while recharging its battery.

Fans reportedly stay off at 200 W AC charging. Around 42 dB at maximum charging speed. 
The Technology Man
+1

Approximately 37 dB in Silent mode, charging at around 280 W. Approximately 47 dB in Turbo mode.

Advertised quiet-charging noise of approximately 22–30 dB, depending on the published specification. Comparable independent charging measurements are lacking.
